description: This file contains test functions for the Swabble configuration loading and saving functionality. It tests serialization and deserialization of the configuration object, including error handling when the configuration file is missing.

methods.name: configRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests saving and then loading the SwabbleConfig to verify the data remains consistent.

methods.name: configMissingThrows
methods.description: Tests that attempting to load a non-existent config file throws the expected missingConfig error.
